The trunk is too narrow (about 25 px wide) to read as a log. It has no visible bark, cut end, or taper.
The top end (114724 at about 447,180) has a small jag, but the broken, cut-off look is weak.

The lower trunk (115125, about 418,260) is placed where the trunk is still narrow, so the 'pale, smooth lower trunk' is not visually distinct.

Labels overlap the figure and each other: 'the tip of the upper root' sits on the root line, 'the tip of the lower root' runs over its own stroke, and 'the trunk's left flank' overlaps star 114855. The labels are cut off at the frame edge.
Roots: 116758 (about 303,363) and 116901 (about 292,442) are fine as tips, but the two roots are drawn as thin lines, not as tapered roots spreading from the fork.

Orientation is correct: the cut top is up and the roots spread down-left from the fork. Star placement on the trunk and fork is roughly right, and the distant background stars are not part of the figure.
